node: Data-center power, cooling, grid interconnection, and site delivery
summary: Expanded the universe around the physical AI data-center chokepoint with five US-listed or US-traded names outside the core seed list. The strongest additions cluster around medium-voltage switchgear, mechanical/electrical contracting, data-center cooling equipment, rack-level liquid cooling, and water/fluid-management adjacencies. This pass intentionally excludes already-seeded leaders such as Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova, Quanta Services, and hyperscalers. Key bottleneck logic: AI data centers are increasingly constrained by deliverable power, transformer/switchgear availability, high-density cooling, skilled field labor, and deployment cycle time rather than only GPU supply.
